description: The four pie charts represent the distribution of categories for different models, namely Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has 2 slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (light orange) making up approximately 75.0% and "Clarification" (dark red) making up around 25.0%, with percentage labels inside the slices. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has 5 slices, with "Misinformation" (orange) at around 38.4%, "Lack of Knowledge" (red) at 22.1%, "Ethical Advice" (yellow) at 16.3%, "Clarification" (beige) at 14.0%, and "Safety" (dark red) at 9.3%, with percentage labels inside the slices. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart has 2 slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (light orange) and "Misinformation" (dark red) each making up 50.0%, with percentage labels inside the slices. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart also has percentage labels inside the slices, while the other charts have them similarly displayed. The charts do not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized. The segments in each chart appear to be ordered by size, with the largest slice first.
